messages.text: Morning. KYCPipeline shows 143 overdue refreshes today, up from 131 last Wednesday. Ops hands the pipeline over to us on Oct 6, so I'd like to be under 100 by then.
Ugh. Is the growth new overdue files or stuff aging out of the 30-day grace window?
Mostly aging out of grace. Roughly 40 are medium-risk individuals whose cycle came due in Q3. The rest are high-risk files with missing docs.
I'll take the high-risk ones with missing docs. Outreach goes out today and I'll log everything in ClientHub. Is anyone already touching those?
Not me, I'm buried in AML alerts. But if any file on your list has an open alert, ping me before you send outreach so we don't tip anyone off.
Will do. I'll cross-check the list against open alerts before anything goes out.
Quick policy check: {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0025}} hits the one-year mark Oct 7. For a medium-risk wealth client, is that a full refresh or are we still on the 3-year cycle?
3-year for full refresh on medium. Wealth only gets the light 12-month attestation. So c_0025 goes in the quick queue, no new docs needed unless something changed.
Email on file ({{CLIENT_EMAIL:c_0025}}) hasn't bounced, so the attestation can go by email. Sandra Stone is the RM if you want her looped in.
Perfect, I'll send it after the sanctions rescreen finishes and cc Sandra.
Separate one: {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0248}} is on the overdue list. Lending client since 2022, so well past 3 years. Lynn Chase is the RM. Who owns it?
That one's mine. Needs a full refresh and the ID on file looks expired. Lynn says the client will upload new docs to DocVault this week.
Heads up, the loan {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00510}} is still open and LoanOrigination reads KYCPipeline status. A lapsed refresh could block any modification or draw.
Good point. I'll tell Lynn there's a hard deadline so she pushes the client. If it slips past Oct 6 I'll escalate it.
Does an event-driven review for {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0174}} go in the refresh queue or with AML? It's triggered by the Sept 8 wire into {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00360}}, fraudscore was 0.79.
AML for now, I'll take it. It won't count toward the refresh backlog. If I find CDD gaps I'll hand it back to you.
Update: 12 attestations sent, 9 already e-signed. The sanctions rescreen came back clean on all of them.
Nice. That puts the overdue count at 134 by my numbers. Still a lot of ground before Oct 6.
Outreach is done for 18 high-risk files. Six have bounced contact details, so I need RMs to confirm current info in ClientHub. I'll post the list in-thread tomorrow morning.
Thanks Heather. Let's do a short sync Monday to plan the handover prep. I'll build an aging report by risk tier before then.
